artifacts.summary: Wired completion_data (completion_summary/roadmap_items) propagation into the nix, nvim, and epidemiology implementer SKILL.md postflight stages via the shared skill_propagate_completion_summary writer, additive-only, gated on the agents' actual 'implemented' terminal status.

completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the completion_data propagation gap in the nix, nvim, and epidemiology implementer skills: each now reads completion_summary/roadmap_items out of .return-meta.json and calls the shared skill_propagate_completion_summary writer, gated on the agents' actual 'implemented' terminal status rather than the dead 'completed' value the research report initially suggested.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system, a per-extension postflight contract has two independently breakable links: the dispatched AGENT file must emit completion_data into .return-meta.json, and the implementer SKILL.md postflight must read it back and write it to state.json. When auditing or extending such a contract, verify BOTH the emitted value and the consuming gate literally match -- a common latent defect is a status gate written against a documentation table's vocabulary ('completed') while the producer agent emits a different value ('implemented'), which silently makes the consuming branch unreachable rather than failing loudly. Cross-check gate conditions against the producer's actual literal, never against the prose or table describing it.

When a skill's postflight stage has no bash blocks at all (pure prose, no bound variables), an inserted bash block must be fully self-contained rather than assuming task_number/project_name/padded_num exist as caller-scoped variables. Bind padded_num via printf "%03d" and project_name via a jq lookup against specs/state.json inside the inserted block itself, mirroring the idiom other bash-containing skills use in their own early stages. skill-base.sh self-defaults SKILL_REPO_ROOT at source time, so sourcing it needs no caller-side setup beyond the source line.

memory_candidates_harvested.disposition: reviewed; folded into consolidated cross-task memories
